name: Ambient AI Scribes
blurb: Tools that listen to visits and draft the clinical note.
title: Ambient AI Scribes
answer: Ambient AI scribes record the conversation between clinician and patient and draft the note for review, and they are the fastest growing AI tool in care delivery. Microsoft bought Nuance, maker of DAX, for $19.7 billion, and large systems such as Kaiser Permanente have rolled scribes out across their hospitals and offices.

reading.body:
Ambient AI scribes are the fastest growing AI tool in care delivery, recording clinician and patient conversation and drafting the note for review.

The pattern is adoption through large institutions rather than individual clinicians. Microsoft paid $19.7 billion for Nuance, the maker of DAX, and Kaiser Permanente rolled scribes out across its hospitals and medical offices. Both moves put the tool inside existing clinical documentation workflows at health system scale.

For AI specifically, the scribe is a narrow task with a clear output, a note a clinician edits and signs. That is why it spread faster than diagnostic or decision support tools. The note stays the clinician's, and consent to record is required, so the model drafts rather than decides.

The data does not give adoption counts, error rates, or time saved. It covers one acquisition and one health system rollout, so it establishes that scribes reached enterprise scale without showing how far that scale extends.

sections.body: Get patient consent to recording, and keep clinicians reviewing and signing every note; the note remains theirs.
